sentences.en: You knew what you were getting into when you enlisted.
sentences.zh: 你参军的时候就知道自己要面对什么。

sentences.en: My father opposed my decision to enlist in the special forces.
sentences.zh: 我父亲反对我去特种部队参军的决定。

sentences.en: I'm beginning to think that I shouldn't have enlisted in the army.
sentences.zh: 我现在开始觉得我不应该参军了。

senses.zh: 使入伍；征募；谋取…的赞助或帮助

mnemonic: 词根记忆：en（进入…之中）+list（名单）→进入（军队）名单→参军
